en: A vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a crowded market square lined with traditional gabled houses and a prominent historic building with an ornate façade in the center. Behind it rises a tall square tower with arched windows, a clock, and a decorative spire topped by a bulbous dome. The lower margin of the card has printed captions identifying the location and a handwritten signature.
